import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)

    S = next(it)
    T = next(it)

    adj = [[False] * S for _ in range(S)]

    for _ in range(T):
        x = next(it) - 1
        y = next(it) - 1
        adj[x][y] = True
        adj[y][x] = True

    P = next(it)
    ans = 0

    for _ in range(P):
        N = next(it)
        prev = next(it) - 1
        ok = True

        for _ in range(N - 1):
            cur = next(it) - 1
            if ok and not adj[prev][cur]:
                ok = False
            prev = cur

        if ok:
            ans += 1

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
